essence: The syllable placement starting from the feet is identified as the fifth placement.
One should place the syllables in order on the heart, navel, hips, knees, and feet.
When this placement is done, diseases cannot remain in the body.
One should place the mantra syllables in groups of four on the arms and feet.
This placement grants duty, wealth, desire, and liberation without doubt.
